audit_items.proof_trace: Both generateAccessToken (L85) and verifyAccessToken (L102) reference the same module-scope JWT_ISSUER constant (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'), ensuring generation and verification are always synchronized. jwt.verify is called with issuer: JWT_ISSUER, which causes the jsonwebtoken library to throw if the token's iss claim does not match, returning null on any mismatch. No alternative JWT generation or verification paths exist in the codebase.
